about: Part 05 section A: Hunt for Arachneida target/marker, Secret Orders Celain target (A3/A4 are Bounty: OFF in True 1.65)

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, '|arachnid;224|', '|Arachneida;1|') WHERE ID BETWEEN 20607 AND 20621 AND TargetName LIKE '%|arachnid;224|%'

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(replace(TargetName, '|Celain Elrich;1|', '|Celain Eirich;1|'), '|Armsman Commander;1|', '|Arawn Commander;1|'), StepText = replace(StepText, 'Celain Elrich', 'Celain Eirich') WHERE ID BETWEEN 20652 AND 20660 AND TargetName LIKE '%|Celain Elrich;1|%'
entries.why: step 3 targeted 'Celain Elrich', a hidden model-1 GameNPC with Flags 13 (GHOST|DONTSHOWNAME|CANTTARGET) nobody can target; the visible Prima encounter necromancer is 'Celain Eirich' (CelainEirich165, L36, 220 units away; Prima Atlas 'Celain Eirich [36]', Uthgard 'Celain Eirich' 36-38). The same statement does P05-B3: step 14 targeted 'Armsman Commander' (five realm keep GuardCommanders, an enemy one once a keep changes hands) and now targets the new neutral 'Arawn Commander' (Allakhazam 351)
